column1: # Plain names for categories (decisions/0068). One line per category whose name visitors would stumble on: its exact
# name in the database, a tab, then the name visitors see. Categories not listed keep their own name (minus a
# "-Retail" or "(Whls)" ending). Near-duplicates share one plain name on purpose, so people see one kind, not three.
# Wholesale and manufacturer categories say so in brackets, so they don't read as the shop. Edit freely, then
# regenerate the migration (or change a name in Admin later).
